verses.text: Ha winhaj Coré yuninal winhaj Izhar yinhtilalkan winhaj Coat, t'a yinhtilal Leví yet' oxwanhxo heb' t'a yinhtilal Rubén, haton winhaj Datán, winhaj Abiram yuninal heb' winhaj Eliab yet' pax winhaj On yuninal winhaj Pelet, ix meltzajoch heb' winh ajk'olal t'a winhaj Moisés. Ix stek'b'ej sb'a heb' winh smolb'an 250-xo heb' yetisraelal. Ha heb' winh ix yak'och sb'a chi', yajalil chonhab' yaj heb' winh, ayoch heb' winh sb'isulok heb' winh tz'ak'an slajti'al junok lolonel t'a yol chonhab' chi'.

Masanil heb' winh chi' ix smolb'ej sb'a, ix b'at heb' winh yil winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón, ix yalan heb' winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --k'okb'ilxo eyik'ancha'anh he b'a, yujto ko masanil onh a onh tik, yikxo Jehová kaji, aypaxek' t'a ko kal ko masanil. ¿Tas yuj tzeyak'och he b'a yajalil t'a kib'anh a onh schonhab' onh Jehová tik? xchi heb' winh.
Ha ix yab'an juntzanh chi' winhaj Moisés chi', ix em nhojan winh t'a sat lu'um.

Ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Coré yet' t'a masanil heb' winh tzak'anoch yuj winh chi' icha tik: --Hato k'ik'an sch'ox Jehová t'ayonh mach heb' yiko'. Anhej heb' sik'b'ilel yuj ol yal yoch t'a stz'ey yak'an serwil t'a altar.

Ha t'a k'inhib'alil k'ik'an, tzeyik'kot he chaynub' yik incienso, tzeyak'anem tzak'ak' t'a yo'ol yet' incienso, tzeyak'anoch t'a yichanh Jehová. Ha mach sik'kanel Jehová chi', haton jun chi' sik'b'iltaxonel yuj. k'okb'ilxo eyik'ancha'anh he b'a a ex ex wetlevita'il tik, xchi winh.
Ix yalanxi winh t'a winhaj Coré chi' icha tik: --Ha ex ex wetlevita'il tik, ab'ek tas ol wala':
¿Tom te jab'nhej yelk'och jun tik he na'ani, sik'b'il ex el yuj ko Diosal t'a skal heb' ketchonhab', ix ex yak'anoch t'a slak'anil yik tze tanhwej skajnub' yet' eyak'an serwil heb' eyetchonhab'?
Ix el t'a sk'o'ol Jehová to tzex och t'a slak'anil, haxo tikne'ik he gana tzex ochxonhej sacerdote'al.

Wal yel a winhaj Aarón malaj yelk'och winh, ¿tas yuj tzeyal chukal lolonel t'a spatik winh yet' masanil heb' ajun eyet' tik? Ha t'a Jehová chuk tzex loloni ayik tzeyalan chuk t'a spatik winhaj Aarón chi', xchi winh.
T'a elanhchamel ix schek winhaj Moisés chi' b'at ik'jokkot winhaj Datán yet' winhaj Abiram yuninal winhaj Eliab, palta ix yalankot heb' winh chi' icha tik: --Max onh b'atlaj.
¿Tom jab'nhej tas tzonh utej? Ix onh ik'elta t'a Egipto b'aj te wach', manh jantakok tas ay t'a sat lu'um, ix onh ik'ankoti yik tzonh cham t'a tik. Ha gana to tzak'och a b'a yajalil t'a tik.

Ha ach tik manhok t'a junok lum lum te ay tas t'a sat b'aj ix onh ik'koti, malaj jab'ok ko lu'um tzak'a yik skawej jab'ok ko uwa. ¿Tom te kistal onh tzila'? Aktejxo onh ak'an musansatil. Manh ol onh b'atlaj kab' tas tzal chi', xchi heb' winh.

Yuj chi', ix te kot yowal winhaj Moisés chi', ix yalan winh t'a Jehová icha tik: --Manh a cha yofrenda heb' winh chi'. Ha in tik, te malaj tas swutej heb' winh, malaj junok sb'uru heb' winh swik'ek'i, xchi winh t'a Jehová.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalanxi winh t'a winhaj Coré chi' icha tik: --Ha ach tik a k'ik'an tzach och t'a yichanh Jehová yet' heb' winh 250 ajun het'ok. Hanheja' pax winhaj Aarón, sk'ochpax winh ta'.

Ha ach tik yet' winhaj Aarón chi', tzeyik'b'at he chaynub' yik incienso, tzeyak'anem incienso t'a yo'ol. Hanheja' icha chi' syutejpax heb' winh ajun heyet'ok tik, tzeyak'anoch t'a yichanh Jehová, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u chi', ix yik'ankot schaynub' heb' winh chi', ix yak'anem tzak'ak' heb' winh t'a yo'ol yet' incienso. Ix smolb'anoch sb'a heb' winh t'a stz'ey winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón t'a sti' kajnub' b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová.

Ha winhaj Coré chi' toxo ix smolb'ejoch heb' winh ajun yet'ok chi' t'a sti' skajnub' Dios, haton heb' winh ayxo och ajk'olal t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón chi'. T'a wal jun rato chi' ix sch'oxan stzikiki'al Jehová t'a yichanh heb' chonhab' chi' smasanil.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón chi' icha tik:
--B'esekel he b'a t'a skal juntzanh anima tik. T'a jun rato tik ol in satel heb', xchi.
Yuj chi' ix em nhojjab' heb' winh t'a sat lu'um, ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --Mamin, yajal aj t'a sk'inal masanil anima, ¿tom tza satel masanil heb' anima tik yuj smul junok? xchi heb' winh.
Ix tak'wi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi':
--Ha tikne'ik al t'a masanil heb' molanek' tik to sb'esel sb'a heb' smasanil t'a spatiktak smantiado winhaj Coré, winhaj Datán yet' winhaj Abiram, xchi t'a winh.
Ix k'e wa'an winhaj Moisés chi', ix b'at winh b'aj ayek' winhaj Datán yet' winhaj Abiram chi', ix b'at masanil heb' yichamtak winakil heb' israel yet' winh.

Ix yalan winh t'a masanil heb' chonhab' chi' icha tik: --B'esekel he b'a t'a smantiado jun makan heb' anima chuk spensar tik. Malaj junok tas ay t'a heb' tzeyama', tato ma'ay, ol ex cham yuj syahelal smul heb', xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix sb'esel sb'a heb' anima smasanil t'a spatiktak smantiado winhaj Coré, winhaj Datán yet' winhaj Abiram chi'. Ha winhaj Datán yet' winhaj Abiram chi', ix elta linhan heb' winh t'a sti' smantiado yet' heb' ix yetb'eyum yet' heb' yuninal.
Ix och ijan winhaj Moisés yalan icha tik: --Icha tik ol aj eyojtakkaneli to a Jehová schekan in k'ulej masanil juntzanh tik, manh yolok wik tzin k'ulej.
Tato ilya tz'ik'an scham heb' tik, ichataxon tz'aj scham anima, syalelk'ochi to manhok Jehová tzin ak'anoch t'a jun opisio tik.

Palta tato ay junok tas to mantalaj b'aj tzuji ol sk'ulej Jehová, ol spoj sb'a lum lum tik, haxo heb' anima tik pitzanto heb' ol b'atkan heb' t'a yol lu'um yet' masanil tas ay t'ay. Tato icha chi' ol aj scham heb', ol eyojtakejeli to ix spatikejel Jehová heb', xchi winh.
Ayik ix lajwi yalan juntzanh chi' winhaj Moisés chi', ix pax lewnaj lum lum t'a yalanh heb' winh chi'.
Ix emkan heb' winh t'a yol lu'um yet' yalyuninal smasanil. Icha wal chi' ix aj satel masanil heb' junnhej ix aj spensar yet' winhaj Coré chi' yet' masanil tastak ay t'a heb'.

Pitzan heb' anima chi' smasanil ix b'atkan heb' t'a yol lu'um chi' yet' masanil tastak ay t'a heb'. Ixlajwi chi', ix snub'anxi sb'a lu'um. Icha chi' ix aj satkanel jun makan anima chi' t'a skal heb' yetisraelal.
Ayik ix yab'an heb' anima oyanek' t'a spatiktak chi', ix el yaw heb', ix b'at heb' elelal, ix yalan heb': Mokab' b'atpax lewnaj lum t'a kalanh a onh tik, xchi heb'.
Hanheja' ix yak'paxkot k'ak' Jehová yik ix tz'apaxb'at heb' 250 ix nhusan incienso, haton heb' ix yak'och sb'a yet' winhaj Coré, winhaj Datán yet' winhaj Abiram chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:

Al t'a winhaj Eleazar yuninal winhaj Aarón to syik'elta juntzanh schaynub' yik incienso heb' winh ix tz'ab'at chi' winh, haton juntzanh nab'a bronce. Slajwi chi' najat sb'at winh stob'kanel tzak'ak' ayem t'a yo'ol.

Ha schaynub' yik incienso juntzanh anima ix cham yuj smul tik, wikxo ix ajkani, yujto ix k'anchaji a ix yak'an incienso heb' t'ayin. Yuj chi', a juntzanh yamk'ab' chi' tze b'o'och t'a lamina'il yik tz'och smusilok altar, yik wach' ayik syilanoch heb' israel, sna'ankot heb' tas ix aj scham heb' yuj schukal, xchi Jehová.

Ix smolb'ankot masanil chaynub' yik incienso nab'a bronce winhaj sacerdote Eleazar chi', haton juntzanh ix sk'an heb' ix tz'ab'at yuj k'ak' chi', ix yalan winh to tz'ak'ji ulaxok, sb'oji t'a lamina'il yik tz'och smusilok altar.

Ha jun tik ix kani yik sna'ankot heb' israel yet' yojtakanel heb' to anhej heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Aarón syal yoch t'a yichanh altar yik snhusan incienso heb' t'a yichanh Jehová. Tato ay junokxo komonnhej sk'ulej icha chi', scham icha ix aj scham winhaj Coré yet' heb' ajun yet'ok. Icha wal ix yutej Jehová yalan t'a winhaj Moisés, icha chi' ix sk'ulej winhaj Eleazar chi'.
Haxo t'a junxo k'u, masanil heb' israel ix och ijan yawaj cha'anh t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón, ix yalan heb' icha tik: --Ha ex tik, ix he milcham heb' schonhab' Jehová, xchi heb'.

Ayik wan smolb'an sb'a heb' chonhab' smasanil t'a spatik winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón chi', ix b'at k'elan heb' t'a skajnub' Dios. T'a wal jun rato chi' ix och moynaj asun t'a skajnub' chi', ix sch'oxan stzikiki'al Jehová.
Yuj chi', ix snitzanb'at sb'a winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón t'a yichanh kajnub' chi'.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi':
--Elanhek t'a stz'ey juntzanh anima tik, yujto ha t'a jun rato tik ol in satel heb' t'a junelnhej, xchi. Ixnhej wal yab' heb' winh icha chi', ix em nhojjab' heb' winh t'a sat lu'um.

Ix yalan winhaj Moisés t'a winhaj Aarón chi' icha tik: --Ik'kot a chaynub' yik incienso, tzak'an b'ut'jok yet' tzak'ak' ayek' t'a yib'anh altar. Tzak'anpaxem incienso t'a yo'ol, tzach b'at t'a skal heb' anima t'a elanhchamel. Tza k'anan niwank'olal yuj smul heb', yujto toxo ix kot yowal Jehová. Toxo ix ja ilya yik scham anima smasanil, xchi winh.

Ix sk'anab'ajan winhaj Aarón chi', elanhchamel ix b'at lemnaj winh t'a skal heb' anima b'aj ayek' molan chi'. Ha yuj jun ilya ix yak'kot Jehová chi' toxo ix yamchajoch scham anima. T'a wal jun rato chi', ix yak'anem incienso winh yik tz'ak'ji niwank'olal heb' anima chi' yuj Jehová.
Ix och winh t'a skal heb' anima toxo ix chami yet' heb' pitzanto. Ichato chi' ix och wa'an jun ilya chi'.
Ha t'a jun rato chi', 14 mil 700 heb' anima ix chami. Ch'ok pax yaj juntzanh heb' toxo ix cham yet' winhaj Coré yuj schukal.
Hato yik ix och wa'an scham anima chi', ix meltzaj winhaj Aarón b'aj ayek' winhaj Moisés chi'.
